description: The fixed safety list (AGENTS.md rule 15). A plain lexical match on her literal words: it will miss things, and it will sometimes fire on harmless phrases - a neutral note to her caregiver is the accepted cost. Recall is not an emergency service. It can be changed only here, through the joint setup with a second reviewer, never by anything said on a call.
